content.title: Launch count screen and status picker in English and French
content.statement: Launch the count screen and the status picker in English and French.
content.context: Two French-speaking growers require the count screen and status picker in French.
content.rationale: To meet the two French-speaking growers' need for those screens in French.

sources.excerpt: - Launch the count screen and the status picker in English and French.
Marc agreed to launch with English and French for those two screens only.
Aisha’s survey found that the two French-speaking growers need the count screen and the status picker in French.
